level_names.admin1: estado (state) or the Distrito Federal: OSM admin_level 4 (level 3 holds the five macro-regions)
level_names.admin2: município (municipality): OSM admin_level 8; in the Distrito Federal level 8 holds its 35 regiões administrativas (IBGE's one municipality there, Brasília, is the whole DF and an alias of it); level 6 holds metropolitan regions only

tips.plate/area-code/calling-code: plate letters (ABC-1234 grey, ABC1D23 Mercosul), a phone number with its DDD ((21) 2541-1234 or +55 21 …) or a CEP (22041-001) readable → `clues.py lookup plate|area-code|postal-code <value> --country br`, then `board.py apply` with `--lr 2` for plates and mobile numbers (the default 20 treats them as strong); an old grey plate's metal strip names the UF and town of registration, read it directly; near Uruguay, check a plate for a URUGUAY band before looking it up
tips.municipal: street-name plates, the electricity distributor's name on poles and meter boxes, sidewalk paving, highway shields (BR-xxx vs a state prefix such as SP-, MG-, RS-) → `gsv.py sheet --points` on each candidate's centre; clues.md lists what each points to
tips.livery: city bus livery → image search "ônibus <cidade>" or "<cidade> ônibus cores"; intercity coaches travel across states and are weak evidence
tips.phenology: vegetation + month: Cerrado and Caatinga look brown or grey in the dry season, araucárias mark the southern highlands; weak alone: it boosts, and excludes only where an entry says so (buriti in a vereda makes the South unlikely)
tips.children: `board.py children Brasil --level 4` for the UFs (if Bolivia's Beni department appears among them, ignore it: it is not a UF); without --level the auto pick takes OSM level 3, the five macro-regions; a state's municipalities: `board.py children "<state>" --level 8`
